patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: classical dance of AP (Kuchipudi), Etikoppaka = wooden craft, Reddi-era favourite festival = Vasantotsavam/Spring festival.
Crafts->place matching (Eluru carpets, Udayagiri cutlery, Narasapur lace, Etikoppaka) and the 1851 London Exhibition carpet designs recur.
AP vs Telangana trap items (Bidri, Cherial, Nirmal) appear, but keys can follow undivided-AP framing.
Most filed PYQs are general Indian dance/festival items from other PSCs; APPSC itself stays AP-specific.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement and 4-way match formats, heavier than APPSC's single-fact style.
